Himmat unchi hai.
Himmat rasta dhoond leti hai.
Aandhere mein hi aap taare dekh sakte hain.
Sunshine ki taraf face rakho, shadow nazar nahi aata.
Darr ke bawajood kaam karna himmat hai.
Grit kendra hai.
Grit future ke liye tough love hai.
Dard saho aur chup rehna seekho.
Grit hope + effort hai.
Khamoshi sab kuch saaf kar deti.
Jab aapne saari sambhavnaayein aazma li ho, toh yaad rakhein: abhi bhi kuch baaki hai.
Silence pressure ko clarity banata.
Sabse mushkil hai act karne ka faisla; baaki sab bas tenacity hai.
Courage hamesha roar nahi karta; kabhi whisper karta.
Grit mushkil cheezein lagatar karna.
Himmat aatma hai.
Grit grit hi hai.
Jeetne ke liye aapko ek hi ladai baar-baar ladni pad sakti hai.
Chuppi sabse behtar jawab hai.
